}

}

  local seed="$ROOT/data/${ticket}-seed.sql"
  local test="$ROOT/tests/${ticket}-regression.sql"
  [ -f "$seed" ] || { echo "missing $seed" >&2; return 1; }
  [ -f "$test" ] || { echo "missing $test" >&2; return 1; }
  f "$DB" "$seed"
  cmd_etl
  f "$DB" "$test"
}
